label: Crop residue retention
note: Uses existing biomass; adds no new water demand.

label: Mulching
note: Reduces evaporation; adds no new water demand.

label: Contour bunds / conservation furrows
note: Earthworks capture runoff; adds no new water demand.

label: Broad bed and furrow (Vertisols)
note: Land shaping; adds no new water demand.

label: Farmyard manure / organic amendments
note: Imported carbon input; adds no new water demand.

label: Cover cropping
note: Off-season cover crops transpire stored soil water in water-limited environments

label: Legume intercropping
note: Short-duration legume intercrops are a standard dryland practice; treated as not competing

label: Crop rotation / diversification
note: Changes crop sequence rather than adding standing biomass

label: Agroforestry / boundary trees
note: Establishing trees in semi-arid cropland creates root competition for scarce soil water before long-term benefits accrue

label: Field margin / hedgerow restoration
note: Uses uncropped strips; minimal competition with crop water
